endpoint_tip: Answer OpenAI API requests at the base URL
restart_tip: End open requests and keep serving
not_in_a_run: This request was not part of a run
keys_note: One key can serve every app. Separate keys are optional: make one per app only to revoke an app on its own. A key works only at this base URL and acts as you.
admin_token_note: The token this gateway was started with. Named keys belong to an account: sign in with one to make them.
name_help: Name it after the app that will use it, so the request log shows which app called.
name_required: Give the key a name, for example the app that will use it.
made_sentence: Key “{label}” made and copied to the clipboard.
revealed_sentence: Key “{label}”. Each reveal is noted in the audit log.
reveal_again: You can reveal it again any time under Your API keys.
shown_once: Keep it somewhere safe: this gateway shows a key only once.
reveal_tip: Reveal this key: only you can, and each reveal is noted in the audit log
copy_key_tip: Copy this key to the clipboard (a reveal, noted in the audit log)
reveal_off_why: Revealing keys is turned off on this gateway: make a new key if you lost this one.
not_revealable_why: Made while revealing was off: the gateway keeps only its hash. Make a new key if you lost it.
docs_note: What is supported, and a first request with your base URL and key.
snippet_note_empty: <your key> is filled in when you make or reveal a key under Your API keys.
owner_reveal_label: API keys can be revealed by their owner
owner_reveal_help: On: each person can reveal their own keys again (kept encrypted, with the key in the data folder; each reveal is audited). Off: a key is shown once, when it is made, and the gateway keeps only its hash; turning it off erases the stored keys.
saved_owner_reveal_on: Saved: owners can reveal their API keys.
saved_owner_reveal_off: Saved: API keys are shown once; stored keys were erased.
keys_empty: No API keys yet. Make one with New key: one key can serve every app.
revoke_tip: Revoke this key: apps using it stop working at once
revoke_confirm: Revoke “{label}”? Apps using it stop working at once. This can't be undone; you can make a new key.
revoked: Revoked “{label}”: apps using it are refused from now on.
account_lead: Lets {id} use the OpenAI-compatible API (/v1) with their API keys. Off: every key of {id} is refused there; signing in to the console is unchanged.
account_keys_empty: {id} has no API keys. People make their own on the OpenAI API page.
account_revoke_confirm: Revoke “{label}” of {id}? Apps using it stop working at once.
auth_0_text: Apps send an API key made on this page.
auth_1_text: Apps connect without a key. Cloud providers still need one.
